# smart-base-block-kinds

The `dak` adapter's 21 block kinds, one folio-block-kind/v1 node per file (bean riit, step 3): kind, builder, label prefix and RDF types. Read off these nodes by smart-base/schemas/dak-kinds.ts and dak-jsonld.ts, and registered for a folio by loadContributions only when the folio's dependency tree includes smart-base (owner, 2026-10-04: a folio sees the nodes of the instances it depends on, option 1 of 3). They replace the blockKinds array contributions.ts returned.

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-block-kinds`, holding `block-kinds`.
